decisions.reason: As a secure personal document storage feature, the ID Vault builds directly on the firm's decades of security and digital identity expertise, enabling it to interpret early results and improve the feature.
The identity-bound digital payment wallet combines the firm's existing knowledge in digital identity and payments, allowing the firm to assimilate usage data and refine the wallet.

Although the NFC tag based login authenticator extends into hardware-adjacent authentication, it still leverages the firm's core authentication and security knowledge, so the firm is likely to learn from early adoption.
The secure payment and wallet framework draws on the firm's established payment and signature capabilities, making it a natural extension that the firm can improve based on related knowledge.
As the flagship secure platform for building multi-service mobile apps, it is the centrepiece of the firm's super-app strategy and builds on all related knowledge areas, so dropping is very unlikely.
The application shielding security library builds on the firm's application-security expertise, allowing the firm to recognise and address vulnerabilities and thus retain it.
